name: The Vale of Eternity

rounds.endCondition: Round end with a player at 60+ points, or after round 10

categories.label: Final score (score track)
categories.hint: Points are gained from card effects and tracked on the score board; can be reduced by effects but never below 0; may exceed 60

categories.label: Summoned cards
categories.hint: Tiebreaker only: number of cards you summoned

tiebreakers.description: Among tied players, most summoned cards wins
If still tied, they share the victory.

endCondition.description: Game ends at the end of the round in which any player has 60+ points, or after the 10th round

notes: family: race-to-goal. No itemised end-game scoring; all points come from card effects during play. Start player begins with 1 point, subsequent players by turn order rank. Solo/expansion not modelled.

sources.title: The Vale of Eternity rulebook (Renegade Game Studios)
sources.section: Points; End of Game and Victory
